notes:
{姪|めい} means niece — the daughter of one's brother or sister. Japanese does not distinguish between a brother's daughter and a sister's daughter; both are {姪|めい}.

FAMILY TERMS:
- {姪|めい}: niece
- ⟦{甥|おい}→甥：13525_oi⟧: nephew
- {姪|めい}っ{子|こ}: niece (casual, affectionate)
- ⟦{甥|おい}→甥：13525_oi⟧っ{子|こ}: nephew (casual, affectionate)

KEIGO:
When referring to someone else's niece or nephew, add お〜さん:
- お{姪|めい}さん: your niece
- お⟦{甥|おい}→甥：13525_oi⟧さん: your nephew

WRITING:
The kanji {姪|めい} uses the ⟦{女|おんな}→女：00559_onna⟧へん radical. It is not used in other common words, so learners typically encounter it only in this family term.

USAGE:
In casual speech, {姪|めい}っ{子|こ} is more common than {姪|めい} alone, especially when talking affectionately about a young niece.
